selected_gaps.gap: No retrieved frontier leaf establishes whether a 2D-or-higher PCM PINN can keep the electric, Joule-heating, thermal, and phase-kinetic residuals simultaneously accurate when a pulse creates moving fronts and new high-frequency modes after the initial condition — stakes: device researchers can accept the wrong switching time, programming energy, or phase topology despite a small aggregate loss, wasting compute and misdirecting device design.
selected_gaps.companion_rationale: heterogeneous_decomposition yields a field-by-regime-by-local-frequency partition of coupled residual and state blocks; architectural_operator_substitution acts on that named partition to replace one global representation with block-specific localized operators that produce the demanded runnable method while retaining the electric, Joule-heating, thermal, and phase-kinetic quantities each block must resolve.
selected_gaps.selection_rationale: This is the most load-bearing gap because it directly demands the method artifact committed by intake.contribution_type and closes the central failure on dynamically generated high-frequency fronts across the electric–thermal–phase chain. heterogeneous_decomposition directly separates slow bulk, fast front, and cross-field residual components for differentiated treatment; the treatment must not regress to global Fourier features, generic causal weighting, XPINN partitioning, weak residuals, or learned residual weights already occupied in method_lineage.

selected_gaps.gap: No retrieved frontier leaf establishes that event order, front topology, and energy balance remain correct for held-out entire device geometries, material combinations, and pulse protocols that shift the spectrum and stiffness beyond training — stakes: reported gains may not transfer across devices or operating regimes, making the scientific conclusion non-general and the model unsafe as a design surrogate.
selected_gaps.selection_rationale: Under shared_evaluation, this sibling uses the same anchor predictions and physical residual certificate but tests them on held-out whole entities that change spectrum and stiffness; removing it makes the anchor's transfer claim unverifiable and opens the obvious reviewer objection that the method only interpolates its training devices and protocols. controlled_diagnostic_design supplies the confound-isolating move by varying complete geometries, material combinations, and pulse protocols while grading event order, front topology, and energy balance rather than relying on aggregate loss.

deliverable_coverage: method — the anchor's heterogeneous_decomposition defines the field- and regime-specific treatment, and companion architectural_operator_substitution implements the localized operators that ship the runnable anti-high-frequency PCM PINN method.

deferred_gaps.gap: No retrieved frontier leaf tests whether one globally aggregated space-time objective over all coupled fields and switching regimes is necessary rather than assumed — stakes: if this shared assumption hides a fast local residual beneath slow-field averages, published accuracy conclusions can rest on the wrong certificate and principled high-frequency PINN design remains blocked.
